notes.title: 0.7.0 - New enemy
notes.content:
[h2]New enemy[/h2]
This update has been a major milestone in the game and even for future games, with the introduction of robotroopers that has taken considerable work to lay the groundwork for locomotion and A.I.

[h2]Restructuring of history[/h2]
Another important change has been a review of the events of the game and restructuring of the maps and puzzles, to accelerate the appearance of the robotroppers and spend less time fighting only against MiGo and Drones.

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
I'm sure I've added new bugs, but at least I've fixed a few others.
The most famous bug that killed you in 15 minutes without dying has been fixed.
I've also fixed some glitches and silly bugs.

[h2]Chekpoints[/h2]
I've added a story point right at the beginning, when you pick up the weapon at the guard post, you can now skip the intro and start shooting.

[h2]A little more history[/h2]
0.6.0 ended after the lockpick, now you can advance a little more with the surprise appearance of [spoiler] Irina [/spoiler] and with three new dialogues.

[h2]Price rise[/h2]
New changes, new price, the game has risen a dollar. Take advantage before I continue making updates!

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 Life and new enemy
notes.content:
[h1]Life[/h1]
To prevent a single shot from killing you I added the gameplay of life.
According to the difficulty you will have more or less life, it is divided into blocks and if you rest you go up the block in which you are.
Except if you play on original difficulty, now you can take more than one hit from the Migos.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33276653/2ef1f112c7115652cd1d0c9aa254858dbbe415f3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Damage indicator[/h1]
When you receive a damage the screen will turn red to warn you and a red bar will indicate where the damage came from.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33276653/81f325fd0c005a41e739bb2c85641e109467f6a5.jpg[/img]


[h1]Enemy Drone[/h1]
Tired of killing migos? A new enemy is presented, shoot at a distance with its four rail weapons, be careful, hide and aim well or it will leave you a strainer.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33276653/615b581d58372a7529eaff4f72b03f33b7d774ec.jpg[/img]


[h1]Hide weapon and life in the Hud[/h1]
Options to play having the screen totally clean of information.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33276653/3646928bca295176ded14d971b4e7026ef53a2e2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Other things[/h1]
Spoiler! Blood where Irina dies
Improved skin weights of irina
Irina hide the nipples in cinematics if you select hide in settings.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3 is here
notes.content:
[b]Update List[/b]

[h1][b]Difficulty[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] New level of difficulty very easy, instead of a skull there is a tit.
[*] The enemies need to be closer to kill you in normal and easy.
[*] Less enemies in easy and normal.
[*] Difficulty window that asks before starting the story mode.
[*] (For 1.0.4 redo part of the map of part 2 and adjust the spawn of enemies)

[list]
[*] The enemies release the ammunition when they die, if you do not pick it up, after 5 seconds it disappears.
[/list]

[list]
[*] You no longer have to press on the screen to control the camera after using an object or ending a dialogue.
[*] Less vertical dispersion and better distributed horizontal shots.
[*] Now we have to move farther away so that the doors are closed with code.
[*] Irina's tracks are now displayed on the last door.
[*] It is easier to press the buttons of all interactible objects.
[/list]

[*] The control panel fuse now has a light pilot, to know that it is pressed.

[b]Gamepad 0.9[/b][/h1]

[*] Speed ​​curve for camera movement.
[*] Adjust the speed of the camera with gamepad in the settings.
[*] Changed running action to the left stick.
[*] Dialogs and door controls now work but there is no button legend.
To open eyes A.
To choose a dialog Y.
